description: The same kinds of classes (controller, calculator/service, plain class, static utility) under very different package styles: sg.gov.agency.cpf.claims.web, com.acme.billing.v2.internal, org.example, the deeply nested gov.moh.platform.common.util.text and the default package (no package line). Line-ending and indentation variety: the ClaimController paste uses CRLF line endings, the BillingCalculator source and test use tab indentation. The scope is an Excel copy (tab-separated, CRLF, header row "File Path<TAB>Change Type<TAB>Module") listing files from five Maven modules. No JaCoCo and no results are pasted.
notes: Classes with no package declaration (09-source-LegacyDateHelper.txt, 10-test-LegacyDateHelperTest.txt) are in the default package: their FQCN is the simple name ("LegacyDateHelper", "LegacyDateHelperTest"). Their path in the scope is legacy-tools/src/main/java/LegacyDateHelper.java (no package directories).

01-source-ClaimController.txt uses CRLF line endings throughout (37 lines) and starts with a /* ... */ licence header whose text contains the word "package" ("This package is part of ...") before the real package line on line 5; the package must be read from line 5, not from the comment.
03-source-BillingCalculator.txt and 04-test-BillingCalculatorTest.txt are indented with TAB characters (Javadoc continuation lines keep their single leading space).
05-source-Greeter.txt starts with a // comment and a blank line before "package org.example;" (line 3).

11-scope-changed-files-excel.txt is an Excel copy: TAB-separated cells, CRLF row endings, a header row that must not be treated as a file, and a Module column. Production classes are derived by stripping "<module>/src/main/java/" and ".java"; src/test/java rows are test files, not production classes.
Module of each production class: ClaimController -> claims-service, BillingCalculator -> billing-core, Greeter -> sample-app, TextNormalizer -> common-lib, LegacyDateHelper -> legacy-tools.
No JaCoCo, results or coverage summary are pasted: actual coverage is NOT VERIFIED for every class.

Every production method has at least one test that calls it directly (ClaimController methods via MockMvc URLs /api/claims/{claimId} and /api/claims/member/{nric}); foldForSearch(null) and TextNormalizer's private constructor are not exercised but that is a scenario gap, not a missing-test method.

TextNormalizer uses a static import of a JDK constant (import static java.util.Locale.ROOT) and regex literals containing braces ("\\p{M}+"). TextNormalizerTest line 23 contains non-ASCII characters (UTF-8).
BillingCalculator.total uses varargs (BigDecimal... lineAmounts) and the test calls it with two arguments.
blankNameGreetsTheWorld runs 4 invocations (@NullAndEmptySource adds null and "", plus "   " and "\t").
